feeds.title: Good Fruit Grower
feeds.description: Good Fruit Grower is the essential resource for the tree fruit and grape growing industry. It covers the growing, packing, handling, marketing, and promotion of tree fruits (apples, pears, cherries, apricots, peaches, nectarines, and plums), as well as juice and wine grape production.

feeds.title: Feasting on Fruit
feeds.description: Feasting on Fruit sharing simple snacks and treats that are secretly healthy under their dessert disguises! Snacking made sweeter with fruit. Vegan, gluten-free, grain-free, and healthy recipes and inspiration for anyone with a sweet tooth!

feeds.title: Tropical Fruit Forum - International Tropical Fruit Growers
feeds.description: Tropical Fruit Forum offers access to not only a wide variety of fruit trees and seeds but also a very broad knowledge base of every kind of exotic fruit plant you can imagine. It brings you in touch with the person you need. This is an invaluable resource for anyone interested in learning about tropical fruit and how to grow them.

feeds.title: Frog Hollow Farm
feeds.description: An online marketplace for farm to table organic fruits and small batch produced gourmet foods. Here you will find all the latest news and relevant information on our operation, as well as some interesting tidbits.

feeds.title: Orchard People - Fruit Tree Care Blog
feeds.description: Learn to grow fruit trees organically in our online gardening workshops. Learn key organic fruit tree care skills in just 8 hours. Susan Poizner is the creator of Orchard People's online fruit tree care workshops and the author of the award-winning book Growing Urban Orchards.

feeds.title: SVZ
feeds.description: Source high quality fruit & vegetable ingredients from SVZ - purees, juices, concentrates and concentrated purees for the food & beverage industry.

feeds.title: Florida Fruit Shippers
feeds.description: A blog about oranges, tangerines, grapefruit, and just about any other citrus that grows in Florida. Florida Fruit Shippers packing house has been shipping fresh Florida citrus to homes and offices in the US and Canada for four generations.

feeds.title: Fallen Fruit Blog Share your fruit. Change the world.
feeds.description: Fallen Fruit began by mapping fruit trees growing on or over public property in Los Angeles. Share your fruit and change the world.

feeds.title: The FruitGuys
feeds.description: We're a family-owned and operated certified B Corporation that delivers farm-fresh fruit & clean-ingredient snacks to homes, offices & schools. We support small farms & sustainable agriculture, and fight hunger through fruit donations.

feeds.title: OK Specialty Fruits Blog
feeds.description: When you're as old as the apple is, it can be hard to get excited about newcomers. Arctic apples are changing all that! The perfect fruit just got even better.

feeds.title: Devgad Mango Blog
feeds.description: The only online blog which feeds you with tons of information about Alphonso mango. Read more to know about the different aspect of Alphonso mango in India.

feeds.title: Stemilt Growers
feeds.description: Explore our blog to find delicious and healthy fruit recipes and easy how-tos and tips. Our website offers a wealth of information about apples and other fruit, including delicious recipes, helpful tips and nutritional facts.

feeds.title: Brothers All Natural Blog
feeds.description: Brothers-All-Natural is America's favorite brand of freeze dried fruit crisps. Healthy snacking, freeze dried fruit recipes & more!

feeds.title: Fruit Forum
feeds.description: Fruit Forum is a web space for anything and everything to do with fruit: we aim to celebrate fruit in all its fascinating diversity.

feeds.title: Fruit For The Office
feeds.description: Fruit for the Office is the UK's original supplier of fine fresh fruit to the work place.

feeds.title: Sage Fruit Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Sage Fruit Blog! We look forward to connecting with you through recipes, educational tools and basic information about apples/pears/cherries.

feeds.title: USA Pears Blog
feeds.description: A blog about our favorite fruit, USA Pears! Serving up fresh pear recipes, pear ripening tips, nutrition information, and fun facts about the ten different USA Pear varieties grown in Washington and Oregon.

feeds.title: The Fruit People Blog
feeds.description: The Fruit People bring you a mix of fruity blog posts covering interviews, recipes and the latest health and nutrition news.
